attributes.content:
**EL-HAZ-1.3 Front turn lamps follow the requests**

FLCM_Lighting shall light Lamp_FrontLeftTurn while LeftTurnLightRequest is 1 and Lamp_FrontRightTurn while RightTurnLightRequest is 1, as received in each TurnLightControl frame.

It shall add no flashing, filtering or timing of its own.

description: Obligation of FLCM_Lighting as FrontLighting in ExteriorLightingDesign (EL-HAZ-1.3).

FLCM is a supplier lamp module. Its realization ImplementedFLCM_Lighting is the interface specification body_can.dbc, which lists FLCM as receiver of TurnLightControl; the lamp behaviour is part of the supplier delivery.
